scope: public pinned native builtin registration; no private source values
public_register_and_default_alias:
register() ->
    register(default_alias()).
register(Alias) ->
    Module = mnesia_rocksdb,
    case mnesia:add_backend_type(Alias, Module) of
        {atomic, ok} ->
            {ok, Alias};
        {aborted, {backend_type_already_exists, _}} ->
            {ok, Alias};
        {aborted, Reason} ->
            {error, Reason}
    end.
default_alias() ->
    rocksdb_copies.
